explanation: Zero almost everywhere; it fires (about 9-10) only at D1 of the last few trials of the episode (trials 93-99), when the previous trial was an a2 choice, went common to S2 and went unrewarded, usually right after a rewarded trial (a second loss in a row, or a loss after a rare transition, gives 0, though a loss right after a fire can still give about 6). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every rewarded D1, after a1 choices, and at all earlier trials in the episode, even when the same pattern occurs.
